jobs.description:
Product Designer, Enterprise (Staff-level / L6)

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Location: Europe remote or London hybrid

The role:

Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. The largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar - it's whether admins, legal teams, and programme owners can actually stay in control.

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to own that layer end-to-end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.

You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions (not just contributing), shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders, and raising the bar on how we think about enterprise design problems.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the Enterprise surface end-to-end, from problem framing to shipped outcomes and iteration - often dealing with ambiguity. You'll reach out to the right stakeholders, get the right eyes in the room, and make decisions independently.

  • Design complex governance and compliance systems that give admins, legal teams, and compliance officers genuine control and transparency. Examples include:

    • Permission models and role hierarchies that scale across thousands of creators without collapsing into chaos.

    • Audit log experiences that make compliance auditable - not just for the system, but for the humans who need to understand what happened.

    • Workspace setup and identity workflows that integrate with real enterprise infrastructure (SSO, SCIM, MCP).

    • License and billing models that admins can actually understand and manage at scale.

    • Analytics and reporting that tell admins whether their deployment is working as intended.

  • Work with technical constraints and possibilities. You'll develop fluency in APIs, widget architectures, developer hub patterns, and how backend systems shape what's actually achievable in the UX. You're not designing in isolation from engineering - you're designing in partnership with it.

  • Drive pragmatic iteration. You'll scope ruthlessly, build POCs to get signal early, and iterate based on what you learn from enterprise customers.

  • Set a design vision for our Enterprise surface and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent. As things scale across SSO, compliance, analytics, and billing, you're keeping the mental model consistent.

You should apply if you bring:

  • Significant experience designing complex, large-scale product surfaces - ideally admin dashboards, governance layers, analytics platforms, or other domains where system thinking matters.

  • Technical fluency. You understand APIs, integrations, how services communicate, how widgets and developer hubs work. You can read a technical architecture doc and understand the constraints it creates for design. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.

  • Systems thinking: not just about interaction flows, but about enterprise systems. You understand how identity systems, compliance regimes, and scale constraints shape what's actually possible in the UX. You think in mental models and multi-step workflows, not single screens.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can turn unclear and fast-moving problem spaces into crisp direction, and you do not wait for perfect clarity.

  • Excellent communication in design reviews and cross-functional decision-making contexts.

  • Experience designing workflows where trust, transparency, and user control are central - helping users feel confident in AI-driven outputs rather than confused or excluded.

  • The ability to leverage feedback from users and customers to ensure the product continues to meet real needs - including enterprise users with high stakes around quality, compliance, and scale.

At Synthesia we expect everyone to:

  • Put the Customer First

  • Own it & Go Direct

  • Be Fast & Experimental

  • Make the Journey Fun

You can read more about this in this public Notion page: https://synthesia.notion.site/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2

Benefits

  • A flexible, remote friendly role based out of Europe or one of our hubs in London, Copenhagen, Munich, or Zurich.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based.

  • A generous referral scheme.

  • Work from home set up.

  • At Synthesia, you can work from anywhere (within reason) in the world for up to 60 days per year!

  • A huge opportunity for career growth as you’ll help shape a market-defining product.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role

  • Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

  • Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.


The Role

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

  • Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts.

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.


What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend

  • Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React,  Python, AWS.

  • End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half."

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together.   • Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

  • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

Marketing Operations Email Specialist

Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We are seeking a HubSpot Marketing Hub specialist to build and run UpGuard's email channel inside Marketing Hub. Email is the primary specialisation: modules and templates, audience selection, suppression, subscription types, and channel reporting.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will configure Marketing Hub, produce and QA emails, and own reusable lists, modules, and reporting. Email channel strategy sits with the Director of Pipeline Marketing. You will work with Design, Development, and Marketing Operations as a core contributor.

What will you do?

HubSpot Marketing Hub and email production

  • Audit the current Marketing Hub email setup: templates, modules, lists, workflows, subscription types, suppression, and reporting

  • Build and maintain the modular email library in Marketing Hub, including drag-and-drop modules with constrained design parameters and user input fields

  • Rebuild recurring emails as Marketing Hub templates using the module library

  • Test the library across common send types and fix issues with Design and Development

  • Document how modules and templates are used so producers can build emails in HubSpot without a designer on every send

Audience selection and suppression

  • Audit commonly used lists and document the audience logic behind them

  • Build reusable active lists and segments from the approved Marketing Hub and CRM property set

  • Implement suppression rules in HubSpot for active nurture, live deal, customer at risk, customer in renewal, and low engagement

  • Add inclusion and exclusion selections to the email briefing and list-building process

  • Partner with Marketing Operations on the approved-property dictionary used for campaign targeting

Intake, scheduling, and QA

  • Refine the existing intake workflow and central email calendar

  • Build QA checklists and HubSpot-side checks into the path from Asana request to scheduled send

  • Surface audience overlap and competing sends before emails go out

  • Add practical email best-practice checks to the production workflow

Subscription, deliverability, and reporting

  • Review and update subscription types and reconversion logic in Marketing Hub

  • Establish a channel-health baseline covering engagement, unsubscribes, spam complaints, deliverability, and contact volume

  • Build recurring HubSpot reports for performance by audience, campaign, and email type

  • Flag contact pressure, low-engagement cohorts, and sender-reputation issues

What will you bring?

  • 3+ years building and administering HubSpot Marketing Hub, including configuration work beyond sending emails from the UI

  • Demonstrated email specialisation: Marketing Hub email, modules and templates, personalisation tokens, lists, and workflows

  • Experience implementing suppression, subscription types, and list governance in HubSpot

  • Ability to document audience logic and production steps so others can reuse them

  • Strong written communication and comfort working with Design, Development, and Marketing Operations as peers

What will give you an edge?

  • Current HubSpot Marketing Hub Software certification

  • Experience with coded HubSpot email modules or HubL

  • B2B SaaS email programs covering nurture, campaign, and product or lifecycle sends

  • Experience with the HubSpot Campaigns object and marketing email reporting

  • Familiarity with Asana as the request and approval layer next to HubSpot

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Lauren, Senior Manager of Customer Success at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Mid-Market, APAC or EMEA team.

You'll own the success of a dedicated portfolio of roughly 40-60 Mid-Market customers — acting as their strategic advisor from onboarding through long-term adoption, and driving commercial outcomes across your book of business. You'll partner closely with Account Management, Technical Support, Product, Solutions, and Engineering to help customers realize real value throughout their lifecycle.

We don't need you to be a marketing expert or a deeply technical one. We need someone who's an expert at asking the right questions — someone who digs until they find the real problem, not just the reported one, and who can influence a customer to make progress and move through blockers. You'll be curious and eager to understand our app well enough to take a customer's use case and turn our features into outcomes that matter to them.

What we value

  • Curiosity about the business behind the customer: You're genuinely interested in how companies operate and enjoy learning your customers' industries and goals. You ask about the why behind a request before recommending a solution.
  • Trusted advisor, not ticket-taker: You build relationships that turn you into a strategic partner rather than someone who simply answers questions. You have well-formed opinions about customer experience and aren't shy about sharing them.
  • Ownership of commercial outcomes: You see CS as a value and growth engine. You take ownership of outcomes across your book and naturally look for opportunities to create more value, partnering with AM on retention and expansion.
  • Comfort in ambiguity: You thrive on complex, open-ended customer challenges — bringing together business context, technical understanding, and creativity to solve them. You're calm under pressure, highly organized, and able to juggle competing priorities across a full portfolio.
  • AI-forward thinking: You're comfortable using AI tools to improve your own productivity and your customers' outcomes, and you bring a growth mindset toward experimenting with new AI-powered ways of working.

What you'll do

  • Manage a dedicated portfolio of ~40-60 Mid-Market customers as their strategic partner across the full customer lifecycle
  • Lead onboarding — running kickoffs and milestone check-ins, and guiding customers to their first measurable outcomes
  • Build a deep understanding of each customer's goals and translate them into measurable, mutual success plans
  • Provide proactive, consultative guidance through regular strategic touchpoints and value-driven conversations
  • Monitor customer health, spot adoption trends, and address risks before they impact success
  • Partner with Account Management to support retention and expansion, and coordinate with Technical Support, Product, Solutions, and Engineering when deeper expertise is needed
  • Own escalations end to end — from identification through resolution — keeping customers informed and confident throughout
  • Advocate for your customers internally by sharing product feedback and influencing improvements to the customer experience
  • Drive AI adoption across your portfolio — coaching customers on AI-powered solutions and modeling what AI-native Customer Success looks like
  • Contribute to the broader CS organization by sharing best practices, improving playbooks, and participating in webinars and enablement initiatives

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years as a Customer Success Manager for technical products, in a SaaS environment
  • Experience communicating with software developers in a technical capacity
  • Opinionated about customer experience — you should have well-formed views in order to give customers strategic advice
  • Fluency in French, Russian, and/or Spanish (we are prioritizing multilingual candidates for this role)
  • Located in Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom or Ireland
  • Bonus: experience designing lifecycle messages

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. The salary for this role is $80,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 30-minute video call with Recruiter
  • 45-minute video call with Hiring Manager
  • 45-minute Homework Review Call + feedback with potential team members

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager

Growth Product Manager

The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As Growth Product Manager at 7NXT Health Group, you drive subscriber growth across all our brands. You find the problems behind our key metrics, test your way to solutions, and make sure what we learn in one brand helps the others. Your focus spans the subscriber lifecycle — with the emphasis on its two ends: acquisition and retention.

You work in close collaboration with Marketing to bring the right people in and find the right offers to keep them: a lot of testing on pricing, offers, landing pages and cancellation flows. This is a mid-level role with real ownership in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll drive

  • You own the experimentation roadmap, from metric to hypothesis to shipped test and clear result

  • You partner closely with Marketing and CRM on funnels, landing pages and campaigns, and own the testing of pricing and offers

  • You share what works across the group, so a win in one brand becomes a test in another

What defines you

Must-have

  • Experimentation and growth mindset. You turn a metric into customer problems and sharp hypotheses, run sound A/B tests, and build a roadmap around what will move the number.

  • Data and customer insight. You do your own analysis, from funnels to test read-outs, and combine it with research and interviews to find the real problem.

  • Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

  • Ownership. You own outcomes end to end and step in beyond your scope when the team needs it.

  • Communication and structure. You align Marketing, design, engineering and leadership around evidence, and document learnings so the whole group can use them.

  • 3–5 years in product, growth or a related role in a digital B2C product, with a track record of running A/B tests

Nice-to-have

  • A marketing background, or experience working closely inside a marketing team

  • Experience in a subscription business: trials, paywalls, pricing, churn and LTV dynamics

  • Familiarity with tools such as Braze, Contentful, Google Analytics or Webflow

  • Experience in a scale-up or PE-backed environment

  • German language skills

Benefits

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

  • 🏖️ 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off

  • 🏠 Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family-friendly benefits — childcare costs & paid sick days for children

  • 🍎 The office classics — fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks

  • 🐶 Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection.

People who make things happen

7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. Through our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo, we reach 20–30 million people per month across 9 European markets, helping them live healthier lives — physically and mentally. Our team of ~170 people grows organically, works at eye level, and genuinely practises what we preach.

We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate.

Everyone counts

At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

jobs.title: Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
jobs.description:
Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Junior Computational Geometry Engineer, you work on the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack: the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model, reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You start on well-scoped parts of that engine, next to the engineers who built it, and grow into owning them. Your code runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • Foundations. Degree in computer science, mathematics, mechanical engineering or a related field, with real depth in geometry, linear algebra and numerics. Internships, thesis work or serious side projects count. We do not expect years of production experience.
  • B-rep Basics. You are comfortable with topology, NURBS, meshes and point clouds. You may never have shipped a robust boolean, and you still understand why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations, and you want to learn how the field handles it.
  • Kernel Exposure. You have worked with a geometry kernel and mesh libraries in at least one project: OpenCASCADE, CGAL, libigl, Open3D, PCL, Parasolid or comparable.
  • Technical Ability. Solid modern C++ (17+) plus Python for tooling and rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write code others can read, test and maintain.
  • Manufacturing Curiosity. You want to understand what happens once geometry meets a spindle, a nozzle or a fixture. CNC, additive or metrology exposure is a bonus, never a requirement.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you dig until you know whether the bug sits in the code, the model or the assumption.
  • Learning Speed. You take direct feedback, apply it immediately, and close your own knowledge gaps without waiting to be taught.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • On-site. Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll help define it.
  • People who treat “it works on the test model” as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.



Apply

  • Resume: Focus on the geometry work you have actually done. Thesis, internships, projects, coursework.
  • GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hardest problem you have solved. Code, a write-up, or a part that came off a machine because of you.
  • Coverletter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist
Inside Sales Rep
jobs.description:
Inside Sales Rep

Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients.

Position Overview

LevelUp is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented, and highly motivated Inside Sales Representative (ISR) to join our clients' newly established sales functions. In this role, you will act as a key extension of our clients' global commercial teams, responsible for driving revenue growth by engaging directly with existing accounting and audit firms within their installed base.

This is a high-impact position often tied to the launch of new solutions. Initially, you will focus on managing high inbound demand, guiding current clients who have free credits through their conversion journey from free-to-paid accounts. You will help customers understand package tiers, address their questions, handle common objections, and close deals directly using CRM tools.

Responsibilities will expand to managing portal escalations and executing targeted outbound campaigns to an installed base using usage-triggered events. The ideal candidate is comfortable with high-volume chat and email sales, holds a high standard of discipline for CRM logging, and possesses a strong curiosity to understand products beyond the surface level. If you are a resilient, target-driven sales professional looking to build a career in B2B SaaS sales, we want to hear from you.

Role Details

• Work Setup: Fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.

• Schedule: Requires flexibility to cover fixed, rostered night/mid-afternoon shifts across North American and European business hours, including Philippine holidays.

Reference: 2641-141224

Responsibilities

  • Respond to high volumes of inbound chats and emails from existing clients utilizing free credits or trial periods. Take incoming phone calls when customers request direct conversations.
  • Guide customers through package options, pricing tiers, and licensing models. Manage common objections using provided sales playbooks and close transactions using assisted checkout in CRM/sales tools.
  • Identify complex, multi-seat, or enterprise-level opportunities and route them seamlessly to named Account Managers, providing clear and detailed handover notes.
  • Document 100% of customer interactions, purchase intent, objections, and usage trends in CRM daily, maintaining high pipeline accuracy.
  • Handle "talk to someone" escalated requests arising from self-serve portals.
  • Run proactive outbound campaigns targeting an installed base based on usage triggers (averaging 40 to 60 touches per day across chat and email) and support seasonal marketing campaigns.
  • Consistently meet or exceed KPIs, including maintaining chat response times under 60 seconds, keeping deal cycles under 5 business days (initial phase) and 3 business days (subsequent phases), and maintaining a CSAT score above 4.2.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in B2B SaaS inside sales, chat sales, or high-volume inbound SDR/BDR roles, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and conversion metrics.
  • Experience closing deals over live chat (e.g., Intercom or similar tools), demonstrating an ability to manage multiple simultaneous conversations with speed and accuracy.
  • Exceptional written English skills (clear, grammatically correct, and friendly) for chat and email, paired with confident, professional spoken English for calls.
  • Direct experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM daily to manage leads, opportunities, and log communication.
  • Complete willingness and availability to work fixed, rostered night/mid-afternoon shifts (covering North American and European business hours) and Philippine holidays.
  • Previous experience selling software, tools, or services to accounting, audit, or financial professional services firms (nice-to-have).
  • High comfort level learning, understanding, and explaining AI-powered analysis or data software products (nice-to-have).
  • Experience converting free-tier, trial, or freemium users to paid recurring plans (Product-Led Growth / PLG) (nice-to-have).
  • Familiarity with CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) workflows or guided checkout systems (nice-to-have).
  • Fluency in French, German, or Dutch is highly valued (nice-to-have).

Communication & Attitude

  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Experience with technical/customer support or regularly interacting with clients on technical matters.
  • A strong team player with a supportive and friendly attitude.
  • Has a proactive and can-do approach to work.
  • Genuinely enjoys helping people solve their problems and cares about the customer experience.
  • Is passionate about continuous learning and self-improvement.

More Information

  • This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week, requiring flexibility to cover night/mid-afternoon shifts across North American and European business hours, including Philippine holidays.
  • We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment.
  • Performance-based commission/bonuses
  • Equipment provided
  • HMO + 13th month pay

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

As a global leader in Intelligent Work Management with a market cap of $10bn, we’ve continued to scale our engineering presence internationally. Since expanding into Bulgaria in October 2024, we’ve grown to a team of 70+ engineers. As we continue building this operation, we’re looking for talented and motivated Software Engineers who are passionate about continuous learning and excited to grow in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Smartsheet runs on a modern SaaS stack hosted on AWS, with infrastructure defined and managed as code using Terraform and strong engineering best practices. Our core platform includes a legacy Java monolith alongside a growing ecosystem of microservices, primarily built in Java and Go (with a small number of Kotlin services). On the front end, product teams that deliver UI experiences use React.

You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to an engineering leader.

You Will:

  • Contribute to the entire development lifecycle, from concept to release, ensuring quality at every step.
  • Participate in system architecture discussions to design scalable, high-availability applications.
  • Implement new features and improve existing functionality to enhance our product offerings..
  • Maintain and develop service APIs that serve millions of users.
  • Collaborate with systems engineers to debug infrastructure challenges.
  • Take part in all phases of quality assurance and defect resolution to maintain the reliability of our systems.
  • Work across multiple disciplines such as front-end, back-end, test automation, and infrastructure to broaden your technical expertise.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

You Have:

  • Experience with programming languages like Golang, Java, C, or Node.js.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js)
  • Knowledge of Object-Oriented design and Microservice Architecture.
  • Experience with scalable, high-availability applications.
  • Comfort working in Linux command line environments.
  • A degree in Computer Science or equivalent industry experience.
  • Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.
  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with DynamoDB, MySQL, or other relational and non-relational databases.
  • Familiarity with AWS and Docker, or AWS certifications (AWS Developer, AWS Solution Architect).
  • Experience with service orchestration tools like Kubernetes or HashiCorp

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. jobs.title: Werkstudent - Product Management / Health (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Werkstudent - Product Management / Health (m/w/d)
DEIN TEAM

ottonova ist Deutschlands erste digitale private Krankenversicherung. Wir leben dafür, unseren Kunden sehr gute Versicherungsprodukte und eine zeitgemäße, einfache und voll-digitale Erfahrung zu bieten. 

Hast du Lust, die Revolution in der Versicherungsbranche mit voranzubringen und an der Schnittstelle von Versicherung, Technologie und Kunde zu arbeiten? Dann suchen wir dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Product / Health Management. Werde Teil unseres Product Teams in München und unterstütze und mit 16-20 Stunden pro Woche! 


DEIN WIRKUNGSBEREICH

Wie können wir Menschen dabei unterstützen, sich besser um ihre Gesundheit zu kümmern? Und wie machen wir Informationen rund um ihre Gesundheit und Versicherung verständlicher? Mit diesen Fragen beschäftigen wir uns im Health Management. Wir erforschen was Kund:innen brauchen, und entwickeln auf dieser Grundlage unsere digitalen Angebote und Funktionen in der ottonova App weiter. 
Dabei unterstützt du uns: Du hilfst, Kundenbedürfnisse zu untersuchen, Ergebnisse auszuwerten und daraus Ideen für unsere Produkte abzuleiten

  • Du unterstützt uns bei Kundenumfragen, sowie bei Interviews und Verständlichkeitstests - von der Vorbereitung und Durchführung bis zur Auswertung
  • Du analysierst Umfrageergebnisse, Kundenfeedback und Kundenanfragen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team leitest du daraus ab, wo Kund:innen Unterstützung brauchen und wie wir unsere Angebote, Erklärungen und Funktionen verbessern können
  • Du bereitest Daten und Erkenntnisse übersichtlich auf, beispielsweise in Tabellen, Auswertungen und Präsentationen für das Team
  • Du wirkst an der Entwicklung digitaler Gesundheitsangebote und App-Funktionen mit: recherchiere, entwickele Ideen weiter, erstelle bei Bedarf einfache Prototypen und hilf, diese mit Kund:innen zu testen
  • Du recherchierst und analysierst potenzielle Kooperationspartner zur Anbindung und Erweiterung unserer Funktionen und Services
  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, aktuelle Trends in der Gesundheits- und Versicherungsbranche zu identifizieren und hilfst bei der Vorbereitung neuer Initiativen, durch die Organisation von Workshops


DEIN PROFIL

  • Du befindest dich in einem Studium der Sportwissenschaften / Gesundheitsökonomie / BWL / Psychologie / Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fach und hast noch min. 1 Jahr Studienzeit vor dir
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert, gehst sorgfältig mit Daten um und hast ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis
  • Du interessierst dich für Gesundheit, digitale Produkte und die Frage was Kund:innen wirklich brauchen  
  • Du kannst dich gut in die Perspektive von Kund:innen hineinversetzen und Erkenntnisse verständlich aufbereiten
  • Du arbeitest gerne mit agilen Teams und fühlst dich wohl in einem internationalen Umfeld
  • Du gehst sicher mit gängigen Office-Tools um. Erfahrungen mit Umfragetools, Figma oder qualitativer und quantitativer Forschung sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (B2) und kannst dich auch auf Englisch (B1) im Arbeitsalltag verständigen.


WORAUF DU DICH FREUEN DARFST

Bei ottonova hast du die Möglichkeit, eines der spannendsten neuen Unternehmen am Markt mitzugestalten. Hier erwarten dich ein erfahrenes, hochmotiviertes und buntes Team und Freiräume, um eigene Ideen einzubringen und voranzutreiben.

Als Krankenversicherung sind wir der Gesundheit verpflichtet – auch bei unseren Mitarbeitenden. Da Obst, Kaffee uns Müsli bei uns zu Ausstattung gehören, bieten wir dir eine Vielzahl anderer Benefits an:

  • Sport- und Fitnesszuschuss
  • Corporate Benefits
  • Ticket Plus City Card 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten
  • Mitarbeitende-werben-Mitarbeitende
 
ottonova fördert einen gegenseitig verantwortungs-, respekt- und humorvollen Umgang mit klarem Wertesystem. Unsere Vielfalt ist eine Stärke, denn sie macht das ottonova-Team kreativer und produktiver. Wir schätzen jedes Individuum und unterstützen die persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung mit vollem Einsatz.

ws-health-management

Integrations Engineer

Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We’ve assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by [Index Ventures] (https://www.indexventures.com/), the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.

About the role

You will join a talented, flat-structured engineering team as our Integrations Engineer, owning how external systems interact with Scope’s platform. You will build the APIs, frameworks and data pipelines behind every integration, and own problems end to end. You will be the 1st Integrations Engineer hire and will build out the team as we scale.

You will not be siloed. You will work directly with our Deployment Strategists and clients to understand their systems, decide what to build, ship it and check it worked. Every integration you deliver should make the next one faster.

We work in person five days a week at our Farringdon office, because we believe it's how we move fastest.

We're looking for people who want to help reimagine what inspection software should look like in a post-AI world, and how it plugs into everything around it.

What you will do

  • Build the core foundations for integrations, including APIs that allow external systems to interact with our platform.

Who you are

What we offer

We value diverse perspectives. If you don't match every point above but have the drive and commercial instincts we're looking for, we strongly encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Credit) - Car Finance
jobs.description:
Data Scientist (Credit) - Car Finance

We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

 

Car Finance at Marshmallow

Marshmallow is opening up access to credit to migrants, bringing a brand new product to market which provides newcomers to the UK with fairly priced car finance for the first time.

Our Car Finance team is building a new generation lending platform from the ground up, making it simple, transparent and accessible for people who need finance to get on the road. We work closely with dealers, brokers and customers to make sure that every application, decision and interaction is fast, fair and easy to understand.

Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders.

The Role

We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working.

Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant.

This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine.

You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build, validate and monitor application and behavioural scorecards, using bureau, Open Banking and internal data to improve how we assess new-to-UK and thin-file customers.

  • Design, test and refine our credit strategy: cut-offs, affordability rules, pricing tiers and limits, with a clear view of the trade-off between risk, volume and margin.

  • Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them.

  • Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning.

  • Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations.

  • Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster.

What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 2–5 years' experience in decision science or data science within consumer lending or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring.

  • Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning.

  • SQL user, and comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets.

  • A solid grounding in statistics and a good instinct for when a result is real and when it isn't.

  • Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You ask why, you dig until you find the answer, and you'd rather ship something and improve it than wait for perfection.

Nice to have

  • Motor finance or other secured lending experience.

  • Experience of working within a rapidly scaling lending environment.

  • Familiarity with UK consumer credit regulation and how it shapes model design and use.

  • Experience using LLMs to speed up analytical work.

  • You already know some of the tooling Marshmallow uses: Snowflake, Python, Claude, Linear, Notion

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Onsite interview consisting of:

    • Technical interview with a couple of the team (60 mins)

    • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

Director of rewards, data & analytics

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers.

Own Total Rewards and compensation

  • Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes.

  • Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE)

  • The ability to explain complex reward and equity topics simply, and to handle sensitive matters with discretion.

  • Fluent English (our working language).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

jobs.description:
Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour.

Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer.

Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Elle accompagne chaque hôpital dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un profil à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet : une personne capable de piloter un déploiement client de bout en bout, mais aussi de prendre en main les aspects techniques de l'intégration de nos solutions.

Si tu aimes autant comprendre comment fonctionnent les systèmes informatiques que coordonner les parties prenantes d'un projet, ce poste devrait te plaire !

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant que Technical Implementation Manager, tu seras responsable de la mise en œuvre technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, depuis le cadrage initial jusqu'à leur mise en production.

Ton rôle ? Faire en sorte que nos solutions s'intègrent correctement dans les systèmes d'information hospitaliers, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des déploiements.

Concrètement, tu seras amené(e) à :

🔧 Piloter et réaliser les déploiements techniques

  • Configurer et déployer nos applications dans les environnements informatiques de nos clients.

  • Mettre en place et configurer les flux d'interopérabilité entre nos solutions et les systèmes d'information hospitaliers (notamment HL7).

  • Travailler avec les équipes IT des établissements sur les prérequis techniques : serveurs Windows, réseau, connectivité, VPN, SFTP, certificats et sécurité.

  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des installations et des mises en production.

📋 Gérer tes projets d'implémentation de bout en bout

  • Organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage technique avec les établissements de santé.

  • Identifier les besoins, les contraintes et les prérequis techniques nécessaires au déploiement.

  • Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs (DSI, équipes techniques hospitalières, chefs de projet, équipes internes Lifen) pour assurer la bonne avancée des projets.

  • Suivre les différentes étapes du déploiement, anticiper les risques, lever les blocages et garantir la qualité des mises en production.

🔍 Garantir le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions

  • Réaliser les tests techniques et fonctionnels avec les clients afin de valider le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions de bout en bout.

  • Analyser les incidents et identifier leur origine (configuration, connectivité, flux, application...).

  • Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 en collaboration avec les équipes Support, Produit et R&D.

  • Surveiller les flux et les certificats pour anticiper les dysfonctionnements.

🤝 Être un interlocuteur technique de confiance pour nos clients

  • Échanger directement avec les équipes IT des hôpitaux pour résoudre les problématiques d'intégration.

  • Savoir expliquer des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs moins techniques.

  • Comprendre les contraintes du terrain pour proposer des solutions adaptées, fiables et pérennes.

🚀 Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos déploiements

  • Documenter les configurations, les procédures et les problématiques rencontrées.

  • Identifier des opportunités pour standardiser, automatiser et fiabiliser nos déploiements.

  • Faire remonter les retours terrain aux équipes Produit et R&D pour contribuer à l'évolution de nos solutions.

  • Développer progressivement une expertise sur l'ensemble de nos produits.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout un profil technique qui aime gérer des projets, résoudre des problèmes concrets et travailler directement avec les clients.

🖥️ De solides bases techniques

Tu as une expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l'intégration ou l'administration de solutions logicielles et tu es à l'aise avec plusieurs des environnements et technologies suivants :

  • Systèmes : environnements Windows Server, administration système, GPO, installation et configuration d'applications.

  • Réseaux et connectivité : TCP/IP, VPN, SFTP, certificats et notions de sécurité informatique.

  • Intégration applicative : compréhension des échanges de données entre applications, des flux et des problématiques d'interopérabilité.

  • Diagnostic technique : capacité à analyser des logs, identifier l'origine d'un incident et conduire sa résolution.

Tu n'as pas besoin d'être expert(e) sur chacune de ces technologies, mais tu dois avoir suffisamment de bagage technique pour être autonome face aux problématiques d'un déploiement.

📋 Une expérience en gestion de projet technique

Tu as déjà coordonné des déploiements ou des projets d'intégration de logiciels chez des clients, en collaboration avec plusieurs interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.

Tu sais organiser un projet, suivre ses étapes, anticiper les risques et faire avancer les sujets jusqu'à leur résolution.

🤝 Une vraie aisance dans la relation client

Tu es capable d'échanger aussi bien avec un administrateur système ou un responsable IT qu'avec un chef de projet ou un utilisateur métier.

Tu sais vulgariser les sujets techniques, poser les bonnes questions et construire une relation de confiance avec tes interlocuteurs.

🛠️ Un état d'esprit orienté résolution de problèmes

Tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, investiguer lorsqu'un problème survient et trouver des solutions concrètes.

Tu es autonome, rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et tu n'hésites pas à mettre les mains dans le cambouis plutôt que de simplement coordonner les actions des autres.

🏥 Une connaissance du secteur de la santé est un plus

Une expérience dans un établissement de santé, chez un éditeur de logiciels de santé ou dans l'intégration de systèmes d'information hospitaliers sera particulièrement appréciée.

Une connaissance des standards d'interopérabilité en santé, notamment HL7, est également un vrai atout.

Mais ce n'est pas indispensable : si tu disposes d'un solide socle technique et d'une expérience en déploiement logiciel, nous pourrons t'accompagner dans la découverte des spécificités du secteur hospitalier.

💎 Nos avantages

  • Package entre 40-47K€

  • Mode de travail : Commuter (3 jours/semaine au bureau)

  • Une carte Swile avec 9 €/jour (50 % Lifen)

  • Une mutuelle santé incluant médecine alternative et soutien en santé mentale (55 % Lifen)

  • 30 €/mois pour concerts, musées ou même pour rembourser ton abonnement Spotify

Your mission

The Senior Project Engineer role supports Menhir Photonics' continued growth, industrialization, and execution of advanced laser technology projects. Your profile

Technical Project & Program Management

jobs.title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate - Belgium (French & Dutch Fluency)
jobs.description:
Sr. Clinical Research Associate - Belgium (French & Dutch Fluency)

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of clinical trials by independently managing clinical site monitoring and site management activities across Belgium, from study start-up through close-out. You will act as a primary point of contact for investigative sites in these countries, ensuring compliance with protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations and study requirements while supporting high-quality patient data and study delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for supporting site performance, resolving issues, maintaining study documentation and providing guidance and mentorship to junior CRAs. You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, sponsors and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic clinical research environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits across Belgium.

  • Ensure investigative sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and project-specific requirements.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned sites, managing site-related questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations through to resolution.

  • Review clinical trial data, source documentation and study systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity and compliance.

  • Support site selection, activation and recruitment activities, working with sites to achieve study milestones and patient recruitment targets.

  • Ensure sites are appropriately trained on protocols, study systems, processes and applicable requirements throughout the study lifecycle.

  • Maintain oversight of essential study documentation, including ISF and TMF, ensuring documents are complete, accurate and filed in a timely manner.

  • Collaborate with sponsors, project teams, vendors and investigative sites to support study timelines, resolve issues and maintain effective working relationships.

  • Participate in audits and inspections, Investigator Meetings, study meetings and other project activities as required.

  • Provide mentoring and support to CRA I and II colleagues, participate in co-monitoring and CRA assessment activities, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Honours) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is preferred.

  • 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience, with 7–9 years preferred.

  • Strong clinical site monitoring experience across clinical trial activities from site start-up through close-out.

  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research principles and applicable local regulatory requirements.

  • Experience with Phase I–IV clinical trials preferred.

  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems such as EDC, IRT, eTMF, CTMS and Microsoft Office, with experience in systems such as Medidata Rave or Oracle InForm preferred.

  • Strong understanding of site management, including site activation, recruitment, training, issue resolution and maintenance of essential documentation.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigative sites, sponsors and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a sense of urgency.

  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment.

  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior CRAs is preferred.

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project requirements and geographic location.

  • Valid driver’s licence required.

  • Fluent in English, French and Dutch.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Sign-On Bonus: This role includes a one-time sign-on bonus in recognition of playing a key role in our initial expansion in this area. (€3,000)

Additionally:

  • Annual Bonus (Short Term Incentive Program) target = 8% of annual salary
  • A monthly stipend of €157.83 (pro-rated based on hours of work), to be paid with their regular payroll/added to their taxable income. This is intended to offset the business use of the employee’s communication costs (internet, VoIP, land line, etc.)
  • Monthly Cell phone stipend (€40)
  • A one time expense reimbursement of up to €500 (local currency) to purchase other office items such as a scanner/printer, an extra monitor, office furniture and supplies, etc.
  • Mileage reimbursement for travel

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

Full-Time Belgium
