jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer

At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

At Cision, we build software that supports large-scale, global enterprise infrastructure. Our teams enable platform, operations, and engineering groups with tools that improve visibility, reliability, automation, and decision-making across complex systems.
We are seeking a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of internal platforms used by enterprise infrastructure teams. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, works independently, and owns systems end-to-end—from architecture through production operations.
You will operate as a technical leader within the team, influencing design decisions, setting engineering standards, and delivering high-impact solutions across backend services, data pipelines, and user-facing applications.

What You’ll Do
• Architect, build, and own full-stack software platforms supporting enterprise infrastructure and operations teams.

jobs.description:
Lead Credit Ops

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.

As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

  • Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

  • Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

  • Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

  • Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

  • Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

  • Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months

  • Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

  • Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

  • Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

  • Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

  • Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

  • By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

  • Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

  • Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

  • Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

  • Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale.

  • Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project.

  • Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Hippolyte (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

jobs.description:
Consultant Psychiatrist (Remote, Ireland)

Our patients have often reached a point where they feel they have run out of options. Many have spent years living with anxiety, depression, PTSD, ADHD or other complex mental health conditions, trying multiple medications and therapies with little success. By the time they reach us, they are looking for a clinician willing to listen, think differently and explore another evidence based treatment option. You could be the clinician that changes that. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Psychiatrists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to contribute to a field that is developing rapidly.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Psychiatrists with excellent clinical judgement, curiosity and an open minded approach to patient care. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and delivering outstanding patient care.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

What you need:

  • Full valid GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Psychiatry

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Compensation (rate reflects weekly commitment)

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks. We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to help monitor, investigate, and respond to security activity across cloud, identity, endpoint, and Linux-based environments. This role requires hands-on technical ability, strong scripting skills, and practical experience working with AWS, with GCP experience preferred.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor and investigate security alerts across cloud, identity, endpoint, and network environments.
  • Review logs and activity from AWS, GCP, Active Directory, Linux systems, Windows systems, and security tools.
  • Support incident response by gathering evidence, validating suspicious activity, and documenting findings.
  • Write scripts to automate repetitive security tasks, log analysis, reporting, or enrichment.
  • Assist with security reviews, including IAM, storage exposure, compute workloads, and network configurations.
  • Investigate authentication activity, user behavior, privilege changes, and potential account compromise.
  • Work with internal teams to understand systems, identify risks, and support remediation, compliance and audit activities.
  • Be available for after-hours incident response when urgent security events require investigation or support.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience with cloud security concepts, services, logs, and IAM.
  • Strong scripting ability, preferably with Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Chronicle, Sentinel, or similar tools.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and Windows systems, command line usage, permissions, processes, and logs.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of Active Directory, including users, groups, authentication, and privilege changes.
  • Ability to read and interpret logs from cloud platforms, operating systems, and security tools.
  • Understanding of common security concepts such as phishing, credential compromise, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and exposed services.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform security, including IAM, Cloud Logging, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPCs, and service accounts.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, containers, or cloud-native workloads.

Minimum Qualifications

Please note:

Knowledge Management Specialist

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Knowledge has the power to shape how an organisation learns, adapts and succeeds. When people can easily find and trust the information they need, they make better decisions, move with confidence and create better experiences for our customers.

In this role, you’ll help build the connections, habits and resources that make knowledge easier to share and reuse. You’ll bring people and ideas together, make expertise more accessible and help teams learn from one another, reducing duplication while creating space for better ways of working.

As a Knowledge Management Specialist, you’ll work with subject-matter experts and teams across the organisation to turn fast evolving product, risk and regulatory requirements into clear, practical and easy-to-find guidance. Your work will help frontline and specialist teams act with clarity, consistency and confidence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate complex onboarding, fraud, disputes, complaints, and account security processes into clear, user-friendly knowledge assets (articles, how-to video guides, process flows, FAQs) for frontline and specialist teams.

  • Work closely with Process Architects and Subject Matter Experts to rapidly capture, draft, and publish knowledge as new workflows go live, keeping pace with a fast-moving launch roadmap.

  • Act as the knowledge liaison between Operations, Product, Compliance, Legal, and Training teams, ensuring content reflects evolving regulatory requirements and product changes.

  • Track and analyse knowledge base performance and usage metrics to identify content gaps and opportunities for improvement.

  • Maintain taxonomy and tagging standards to ensure content findability and effective AI/assistant integration.

Relevant Experience

  • Experience in knowledge management, content creation, learning and development or instructional design.

  • Hands-on experience with a knowledge platform (e.g. Confluence, Zendesk, Notion).

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing requirements, with experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment (high-growth fintech a plus).

  • Working knowledge of operations, including familiarity with operational processes, workflows and the day-to-day realities of the teams you'll be supporting.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to simplify and accurately represent complex operational, risk, and regulatory processes.

  • Detail-oriented approach with excellent proofreading, editing, and content quality assurance skills.

  • A proven track record of collaborating effectively with Subject Matter Experts and cross-functional teams to gather high-stakes information quickly.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing content priorities across multiple workstreams.

  • Working knowledge of KM metrics and reporting (content freshness, coverage, search success, deflection) and the ability to communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting a new team or product launch, where knowledge and process are being built in parallel.

  • Understanding of learning design, instructional writing or adult learning principles.

  • Familiarity with workflow automation, AI-assisted content creation, emerging knowledge technologies, and AI-assisted search or chatbots for knowledge sharing.

  • Experience working with crypto and blockchain products, with an understanding of their operational and regulatory considerations.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Lead Fraud & AML Ops

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

  • Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

  • Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

  • Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

  • Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

  • Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

First 6–12 months

  • Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

  • Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

  • Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

  • By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

  • Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

  • Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

  • Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

  • Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

  • Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

  • Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

  • Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Senior Data Scientist

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

  • Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

  • Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

  • Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

  • Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

About You

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

  • You can do 2 or more of the following:

  • Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

  • Develop and deploy NLP solutions

  • Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

  • Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

  • You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

  • You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

  • You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

  • You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

Cybersecurity Management Consultant(m/w/d)
YOUR TASKS

CRA, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, the EU AI Act – our clients face a wide range of regulatory requirements. For most companies, however, the path from regulatory requirements on paper to effective implementation in practice is far from clear.
For our Munich-based Cyber Team, we are looking for you if you want to support our clients on this journey:

  • You support our clients in implementing regulatory and cybersecurity-related requirements – from NIS2 and DORA to eIDAS and the EU AI Act – and translate them into processes that are actually embedded in day-to-day operations
  • You develop analyses, concepts, and target operating models in the context of complex and emerging cybersecurity topics (e.g. digital identity management, AI security, or AI observability) and drive their implementation through to completion
  • Depending on your professional experience, you lead projects as a project manager or take responsibility for individual work packages and workstreams
  • You assess existing structures, identify risks and gaps, and derive concrete measures and implementation plans from your findings
  • You collaborate with different teams on the client side (IT, Business, Compliance) to develop sustainable and effective solutions
  • You present complex topics in a way that is convincing both in expert-level discussions and at board-level meetings
  • You take on responsibility for your own work packages early on and, as your experience grows, progress into sub-project and project leadership roles
  • Beyond client projects, you contribute to internal initiatives, proposals, and the development of our Cybersecurity Practice by staying up to date with current developments in cybersecurity and regulation and bringing new ideas into client projects and internal initiatives


YOUR PROFIL

  • You have a strong understanding of IT and are interested in developing your knowledge in new and complex topics; in-depth technical expertise is not a prerequisite
  • You have completed a degree with good to very good results in business administration, (business) informatics, engineering, mathematics, natural sciences, or a comparable field
  • You have at least two years of professional experience in a relevant environment, ideally in consulting or a strategic role
  • You work in a structured manner, think analytically, and enjoy making complex topics easy to understand and suitable for management audiences
  • You communicate confidently and effectively with different target audiences and enjoy presenting complex topics in a concise, professional, and audience-appropriate manner across different formats
  • You demonstrate initiative, energy, a willingness to learn, and a strong team spirit, and you are happy to take on responsibility
  • You possess excellent German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.

jobs.title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
jobs.description:
(Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
Deine Rolle

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt.

Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:

  • End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand.
  • Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen.
  • Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren.
  • Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf.
  • Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen.
  • Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Background: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.
  • Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen.
  • Markengespür & Kundenfokus: Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.
  • Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst absolut fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch gut verständigen.


Warum StudySmarter?

Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

  • Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

  • Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

  • Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares).

  • Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training.

  • Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team.

  • Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

  • Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

  • Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen


Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

jobs.title: Customer Success Advisor - German speaking
jobs.description:
Customer Success Advisor - German speaking

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

Customer Service Advisors are the first point of contact for potential customers as well as new and existing customers, and thus the “face” of iwoca. You handle incoming calls, emails and web chats, supporting entrepreneurs with general inquiries, new applications and repeat loans. You highly value our customer service and support customers with your excellent communication skills so they can successfully utilise our products.

A fundamental component for our success is to convince and inspire customers and partners of our mission - this ranges from hair salons and dental practices to financial advisory services and banks.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and always looking to improve.

  • You enjoy communicating with customers and live "customer centricity". Your greatest motivation is achieving success with our customers.

  • You have completed a commercial training / business studies (kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium) and can add value with relevant professional experience in customer service (experiences in the banking environment or a fintech are a plus).

  • You are highly motivated, organised, a true team player and have a 'hands-on' mentality.

  • You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office.

  • An independent, team-oriented and reliable way of working is a given.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

Your mission:

  • You are responsible for the overall customer satisfaction and ensure that customer inquiries via phone, email or web chat are handled promptly and efficiently.

  • You answer questions about our products, the application process and our service in general, supporting both new and existing customers.

  • You assist entrepreneurs in completing their applications and providing the necessary documents required for a credit decision.

  • You collaborate with various teams within iwoca to achieve the best outcome for our customers.

  • You proactively participate in the development of iwoca by providing regular insights on customer feedback, opportunities to improve our processes or new offerings from our competitors.

Work-life balance is incredibly important at iwoca and we offer flexible working so you can make better use of your free time. This is a hybrid role in which you can split your time between the office and home.

We want to make iwoca a place where everyone feels welcome, where you can confidently be yourself. We understand that inclusivity, and diversity that comes through greater inclusivity, isn't an optional add-on; it's the core ingredient of what makes us great. We care about making iwoca a healthy and happy community for all of our team members to thrive in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £28,000 — £36,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: Events Lead
jobs.description:
Events Lead

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With our Partnerships team, design, plan, and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable execution model for international expansion.

  • Establish and manage a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between physical moments.

Customer & Partner Experiences

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, conceptualise and execute high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, interactive virtual showcases, and partner roundtables).

  • Align event formats with commercial and ecosystem goals to deepen partner trust and engagement.

Conferences, Sponsorships & Internal Events

  • Own CuspAI's strategic presence at major industry and machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and materials science summits).

  • Evaluate sponsorship packages, oversee booth design and recruitment stands, manage on-site logistics, and report on return on investment.

  • Partner with internal operations teams to help deliver internal company moments (e.g. CuspCon, company offsites, and all-hands).

Event Operations & Physical Brand Experience

  • Source, negotiate with, and direct external production agencies, AV suppliers, local vendors, and freelance event staff.

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing, and Creative teams to bring CuspAI's visual brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Own event budgets, timelines, and post-event analytics, providing clear reporting to leadership on performance and cost efficiency.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

jobs.title: Value Strategist
jobs.description:
Value Strategist

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

In this role you will

  • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

  • Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

  • Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

  • Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

  • Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

  • Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

  • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

  • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

  • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

  • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

  • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

  • Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

  • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

  • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

  • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

  • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

  • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points

  • Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

  • Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

  • Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

  • Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location

This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Enterprise Account Executive, Iberia

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

As a founding Enterprise Account Executive for Iberia, you will own a book of 13-25 Enterprise accounts across Spain and/or Portugal, running full-cycle deals from discovery to close in 3-9 months. You'll sell value directly to operative buyers, with new-logo generation as a core part of the role as we grow Cresta's brand across the region.

As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up.

  • Manage a portfolio of 13-25 Enterprise accounts in Spain and/or Portugal

  • Prioritize new-logo generation as a key part of growing Cresta's brand and footprint in the region
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience

  • Track record closing deals of €80K-€400K ARR on 3-9 month cycles, running multiple parallel deals end-to-end with limited overlay support, including self-sufficient demos
  • New-logo-first motion, with demonstrated logo velocity rather than an account-management/expansion quota

  • Early-stage or market-launch experience — comfortable operating without brand pull, playbooks, or local marketing support

Language & Travel:

Perks & Benefits:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

Senior Accountant (6-Month Contract)

Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. Reporting to the Accounting Lead, this role covers accruals, month-end and year-end close, audit preparation, and financial statement preparation.
