jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer

Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Senior Product Designer, you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship. You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders. It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work

Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling.

You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated.

What You'll Do:

  • Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities.

  • Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices.

  • Work closely with Research, Product Management, and Development: request and apply insights, align on business requirements, and validate technical feasibility.

  • Write clear specifications so design intent is unambiguous, and run design QA against both the intent and the Kinsta Design System.

  • Give clear rationale for your decisions, resolve design and product deadlocks, escalate when you need feedback or mediation, and communicate trade-offs when priorities compete.

  • Serve as Project Owner on occasion. We don't have full-time delivery managers, so one team member leads each project as its Owner during delivery, communicating progress and coordinating releases.

  • Be a product expert: know how our product works, the personas and use cases we support, and how that translates into UI-level design solutions.

  • Represent the craft: uphold professional standards in design thinking, problem solving, usability, UX, and UI; give and receive design critique; and help maintain and evolve the Kinsta Design System.

What You Bring To The Role:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience as a Product or UX Designer.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping products and features from zero to production, with the ability to carry a project fully autonomously.

  • Experience working in a SaaS environment, on a highly technical product, in cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on experience across the full design workflow: research, problem definition, ideation and facilitation, creating UI, and partnering in delivery.

  • Expert-level proficiency with Figma.

  • Experience working with and maintaining a design system.

  • A portfolio with at least one case study taking a project from a problem statement to a delivered solution. We want to see your process and how you arrived at decisions, not only screens and a general workflow description.

  • A good understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JS). You don't need to write production code, but you should have a working sense of feasibility and be comfortable poking at things in an Inspector.

  • Proactivity: you take the initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience working on a hosting or web infrastructure product.

  • Experience with technical products where the audience is developers or technology-oriented users.

  • Experience with the WordPress ecosystem.

  • Experience mentoring or leading other designers.

Benefits:

  • Annual remote expense budget.

  • Flexible PTO.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

  • Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

  • Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

  • Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

Compensation

Additional Information

We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Account Executive (m/f/d)

Standort: München
Art: Vollzeit

Sales an Vertriebsteams in Enterprises ist die Champions League - und Bliro ist dein Ticket rein. Du verkaufst an Enterprise-Unternehmen, lernst von einem Team, das genau das schon macht, und wirst Teil einer Growth-Story.

About Bliro

Bei Bliro revolutionieren wir den Arbeitsalltag von Außendienstteams mithilfe von KI. 2.5 Millionen Außendienstler allein in Deutschland verlieren täglich Stunden an manuelle Nachbereitung. Bliro löst genau das - mit Transkription und den KI-Voice-Agents Vicky und Tim, die Kundengespräche vor-und nachbereiten, Besuchsberichte dokumentieren und das CRM in Echtzeit aktualisieren. Per Sprache wird so die gesamte Schreibtischarbeit automatisiert und der Außendienst gesteuert.

Schon heute vertrauen über 2.000 Unternehmen auf Bliro - darunter schnell wachsende Start-ups, etablierte Corporates und mittelständische Unternehmen (z.B. igus, Lanxess und Telefonica Deutschland). Unterstützt von Top-Investoren, suchen wir nun dich als Vollzeitmitglied im Bereich Account Executive (AE), um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben.

Unser Sales Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software Unternehmen der Welt (Ex-Deel, Ex-Autodesk, Ex-Celonis) und eigenen Unternehmensgründungen mit!

👇 Sieh selbst, was du an Vertriebsteams verkaufen wirst:

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Executive bei Bliro verantwortest du den gesamten Sales-Cycle - von der Demo bis zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserem SDR-Team, das deinen Kalender mit qualifizierten Demos füllt, damit du dich auf das konzentrieren kannst, was du am besten kannst: Deals zu closen.

  1. Sales-Prozess führen und gewinnen

  • Du leitest Discovery Calls und maßgeschneiderte Produkt-Demos mit Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Prospects.

  • Du baust starke Beziehungen zu Key Stakeholdern und Entscheider:innen auf.

  • Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Cycles und verhandelst Verträge mit ACVs von 50k€+.

  1. Mit dem gesamten Go-to-Market-Team zusammenarbeiten

  • Du arbeitest eng mit den SDRs zusammen, die deine Termine buchen - für einen reibungslosen Handoff und enge Zusammenarbeit.

  • Arbeite eng mit dem Customer Success Team für reibungslose Handoffs sowie mit Growth zur Schärfung unserer GTM-Strategie.

  • Du teilst Feedback aus dem Feld, um unsere Roadmap mitzugestalten.

  1. Quota übertreffen und Wachstum vorantreiben

  • Du clost konsequent neues Business, um die ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen - und zu übertreffen.

  • Du baust deine Pipeline in Schlüsselbranchen und -regionen aus.

  • Du positionierst Bliro als vertrauenswürdigen Partner für Kunden, die ihre Vertriebsprozesse mit KI transformieren wollen.

🧠 Dein Profil

Wir suchen motivierte AEs, die für High-Touch-B2B-SaaS-Sales brennen und mit einem kategoriedefinierenden AI-Startup wachsen wollen.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge im Abschluss von Mid-Market- und Enterprise-SaaS-Deals (ACVs von 50k€ und mehr).

  • Erfahrung in der Verantwortung des gesamten Sales-Cycles - vom Erstgespräch bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag.

  • Exzellente Kommunikations- und Beziehungsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Team-first-Mentalität.

  • Fließende Deutsch- (C2) und Englischkenntnisse (C1+).

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit direkter Exposure zu C-Level, Sales Leadern und IT - nicht nur komplexen Stakeholder-Settings im Allgemeinen.

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an den industriellen Mittelstand in DACH.

💡 Warum Bliro

🚀 Klarer Karrierepfad - kein Blindflug
Bei uns weißt du von Tag 1, wohin die Reise geht. Als AE übernimmst du von Anfang an echte Deals, echte Kunden und echte Verantwortung. Wer kontinuierlich seine Targets hitted, kann sich bei uns in Richtung Senior AE oder Sales Lead weiterentwickeln. Kein Versprechen ins Blaue, sondern ein klarer Plan.

💸 Vergütung + Extras, die sich sehen lassen können
Bei uns bekommst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt, einen variablen Bonus ohne Deckel, VSOPs, Deutschlandticket, Wellpass sowie Essen und Trinken im Office. Dein Einsatz wird direkt belohnt. Learning Budget? Haben wir. Sales-Library? Klar. Persönliches Coaching, das dich aufs nächste Level bringt? Auch dabei.

🌍 30+ Köpfe, 10+ Länder, ein Netzwerk
Bei uns triffst du auf Kreativität und Internationalität. Du arbeitest mit Menschen, die mitdenken, mitlachen und mit dir wachsen wollen. Außerdem bringt unser Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software-Unternehmen der Welt mit. Dazu profitierst du von unserem starken Netzwerk im Münchner Startup-Ecosystem - mit Verbindungen zu VCs und Gründern.

📍 Office-Lage, die kaum zu toppen ist

Unser Büro sitzt direkt über dem Augustiner Stammhaus - mitten in München. Ob Mittagspause mit Blick auf die Stadt oder schnelles Feierabendbier um die Ecke: bessere Nachbarschaft gibt's kaum.

🥳 Echter Teamspirit, jeden Monat

Wir warten nicht auf den Jahres-Offsite. Bei Bliro gibt's monatliche Team-Events - von Minigolf und Bowling über Burrito Nights bis Pickleball. Spontane Lunches und Coffee Breaks inklusive.

🧑‍💻 Flexibel
9 to 5 ist nicht dein Ding? Kein Problem. Ob vom Küchentisch oder aus dem Office - bei uns zählt das Ergebnis, nicht der Aufenthaltsort. Und ja, auch Pyjamahosen sind im Homeoffice offiziell erlaubt.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You'll never close alone

Dein Start bei Bliro wird begleitet von einem Buddy, der dich einführt, auffängt und mit Memes versorgt. Wir sind Teamplayer - von Tag eins bis zu deinem ersten erfolgreichen Closing (und darüber hinaus).

Du hast Lust, den Vertrieb eines KI-Startups von Grund auf mitzuerleben und mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Let’s build the future of Field Sales – together. 💥

jobs.title: Head of Quality Assurance – Industrial Corrosion Protection (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Head of Quality Assurance – Industrial Corrosion Protection (w/m/d)

Unser Kunde

Ein traditionsreiches Unternehmen im industriellen Korrosionsschutz mit über 120 Jahren Erfahrung. Es fertigt und beschichtet Stahl‑ und Edelstahlbehälter sowie Rohrsysteme für die Chemie‑ und Energiebranche und beschäftigt rund 60‑65 Fachkräfte am Standort Bockenem. Das Unternehmen ist Teil einer internationalen Eigentümerstruktur und verfolgt eine wachstumsorientierte Strategie.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Hohe Verantwortung als Leiter des gesamten QA‑Teams
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit dank flacher, teamorientierter Hierarchien
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung in einem stabilen Traditionsunternehmen
  • Technische Vielfalt: Korrosionsschutz, Stahlbehälterbau und Schweißtechnik
  • Dienstwagen als Mobilitäts‑Benefit
  • Direkter Einfluss auf anspruchsvolle Projekte im Chemie‑ und Energieanlagenbau

Deine Aufgaben

  • Umsetzung, Aufrechterhaltung und Weiterentwicklung der QM‑Systeme nach ISO 9001, ISO 45001, DGR 2014/68/EU und SCC‑VAZ 2021
  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des QA‑Teams (2 Mitarbeiter)
  • Ansprechpartner für Kunden und Lieferanten zu allen Qualitätsthemen
  • Planung und Durchführung von System‑, Überwachungs‑ und Zertifizierungsaudits
  • Analyse von internen Fehlern und Kundenreklamationen, Ableitung und Verfolgung von Korrekturmaßnahmen
  • Organisation und Begleitung von Abnahmen im Behälter‑ und Korrosionsschutzbau
  • Durchführung bzw. Koordination zerstörungsfreier Prüfungen (z. B. RT Level II)

Dein Profil

  • 5–10 Jahre Erfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement von Stahlbehälter‑ oder Apparatebau, inkl. Führungserfahrung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Normen ISO 9001, ISO 45001, DGR 2014/68/EU, SCC‑VAZ 2021, AD 2000, EN 13445 und 14890
  • Praktische Erfahrung in Schweißtechnik und Druckgeräterichtlinie
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1), Englisch wünschenswert
  • Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Keine Erfahrung im Stahlbehälter‑ oder Korrosionsschutzbereich – fehlendes Fachwissen ist ein Dealbreaker
  • Präferenz für reines Home‑Office – Präsenz am Standort ist Pflicht
  • Unzureichende Deutschkenntnisse – Kommunikation auf Deutsch ist unerlässlich
  • Wunsch nach reiner Remote‑Führung – Hands‑on‑Präsenz wird erwartet

Deine Benefits

  • Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis mit attraktivem Gehalt bis 120 k €
  • Dienstwagen inklusive – Mobilität ist gesichert
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub
  • Lange, persönliche Einarbeitung durch den aktuellen Stelleninhaber
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Vielfältige, technisch anspruchsvolle Projekte im Chemie‑ und Energieanlagenbau
  • Stabilität eines Traditionsunternehmens seit 1899

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Vollständige fachliche und disziplinarische Verantwortung für das QA‑Team
  • Gestaltungsfreiraum in einem wachsenden, internationalen Umfeld
  • Direkter Kundenkontakt und Projektbeteiligung von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

jobs.title: Digital Experience Manager:in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Digital Experience Manager:in (m/w/d)

Wir bei HAAS bieten seit mehr als 25 Jahren hochwertige Fort- und Weiterbildungen im Steuerrecht für Steuerberater:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen in steuerberatenden Unternehmen.

Puh, Steuerrecht?! Keine Angst, weiterlesen lohnt sich:

Pro Jahr veranstalten wir ca. 600 Präsenzseminare in ganz Deutschland und produzieren in unserem hauseigenen Studio etwa 100 Webinare sowie weitere Video-Formate für Social Media. Unsere Zielgruppe vertraut und schätzt uns als zentrale Anlaufstelle, um zu allen Änderungen im Steuerrecht auf dem neuesten Stand zu bleiben. Im Herzen der Südstadt von Hannover planen und organisieren wir diese Veranstaltungen und alles, was dazugehört.

Als Digital Experience Manager:in bei HAAS verantwortest du die digitale Kundenerfahrung – von unserer Website über Inhalte und Conversion-Strecken bis zu den dahinterliegenden Prozessen und Systemen. Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marketing, Technologie und unseren Kunden und entwickelst unser digitales Angebot kontinuierlich weiter.

DEINE ROLLE BEI UNS

Konkret verantwortest du zu gleichen Teilen drei Aufgabenbereiche:

1. Du machst unsere Website jeden Tag ein Stück besser.

Du verantwortest bzw. steuerst die Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung sämtlicher Inhalte unserer Website.

  • Seminar- und Webinarbeschreibungen

  • Landingpages

  • Produktankündigungen

Du bereitest komplexe steuerliche Inhalte verständlich, zielgruppengerecht und nutzerfreundlich auf. Dabei denkst du stets aus Sicht unserer Kunden und hinterfragst bestehende Inhalte kontinuierlich:

  • Versteht man das?

  • Ist das relevant?

  • Ist das die bestmögliche Lösung?

  • Wird der Nutzer optimal geführt?

Aktualität, Qualität und Konsistenz unserer Inhalte sind dabei dein persönlicher Anspruch.

Nach deiner Einarbeitung verstehst du nicht nur, was auf unserer Website passiert, sondern auch, was dahinterliegt. Du kennst die relevanten Systeme und Datenflüsse, kannst Fehler eingrenzen und erkennst selbstständig Verbesserungspotenziale.

2. Du analysierst, statt zu reporten

Du arbeitest datengetrieben und maximal kundenzentriert.

Hierzu analysierst du regelmäßig:

  • Website-KPIs

  • Teilnehmerzahlen

  • Nutzerverhalten

  • Suchanfragen

  • Wettbewerber

  • Conversion-Strecken

Du baust die Auswertungen und Dashboards, die du dafür brauchst, erkennst Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Für dich beginnt Analyse mit der Auswertungund endet mit konkreten Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale frühzeitig, entwickelst eigene Ideen und setzt diese konsequent um.

In enger Abstimmung mit dem restlichen Team identifizierst du kleine und große Verbesserungspotenziale am Produkt und der Website und setzt diese kontinuierlich.

3. Du machst Technologie für uns nutzbar

Wir suchen jemanden, der moderne digitale Werkzeuge versteht, beherrscht und aktiv weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Systeme ein und fühlst dich in digitalen Plattformen zuhause.

Nach deiner Einarbeitung entwickelst du unsere digitale Infrastruktur eigenständig weiter und identifizierst fortlaufend Potenziale zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse.

Dazu gehören beispielsweise:

  • KI-gestützte Content-Erstellung

  • Automatisierte CMS-Workflows

  • Prozessautomatisierungen

  • Daten analysieren und nutzbar machen – beispielsweise mithilfe von SQL und KI

  • Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Systemen

Neue Funktionen und Möglichkeiten in unserem CMS Pimcore erschließen sich dir schnell. Du probierst Dinge aus, denkst mit und bringst aktiv Verbesserungsvorschläge ein.

KI ist für dich selbstverständlich

KI ist für dich kein Sonderthema, sondern ein selbstverständliches Arbeitswerkzeug. Du nutzt Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude, um schneller und besser zu arbeiten, entwickelst eigene Workflows und erkennst wiederkehrende Aufgaben, die sich vereinfachen oder automatisieren lassen. Dabei verstehst du sowohl die Möglichkeiten als auch die Grenzen der Technologie.

Erste Erfahrungen mit Notion, Pimcore, CleverReach, Make, n8n oder vergleichbaren Plattformen wären ein Plus. Entscheidender ist für uns, wie schnell und eigenständig du dich in neue Systeme einarbeitest.

jobs.title: System Test Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
System Test Engineer (m/f/d)

As a System Test Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and operational performance of our unmanned systems (aircraft, vehicle).You will develop a deep understanding of our products, their system & software architecture, hardware components, interfaces, and operational use cases. Based on system and software requirements, you will define effective verification strategies, specify test cases, and execute tests across different test environments (simulation and hardware-in-the-loop setups).

This position combines analytical system thinking, hands-on testing, and test automation. You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, simulation, and flight-test teams to identify risks, uncover defects, and provide objective evidence that our products meet their intended requirements. By continuously improving our verification methods, test coverage, and automation, you will contribute directly to the safety, reliability, and successful release of our next-generation unmanned aircraft systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop a test strategy to validate our entire software stack for unmanned systems (vertical take-off and landing aircraft (VTOL), unmanned ground vehicle).

  • Understand the architecture, functionality, interfaces, and operational behavior of our unmanned systems.

  • Evaluate and develop AI-powered testing solutions, including AI agent-based systems, to automate test implementation, improve test generation, and increase the efficiency of our verification processes.

  • Create new end-to-end integration tests.

  • Review, challenge, and optimize existing test cases.

  • Proactively expand test coverage in a structured way to identify and push system limits.

  • Develop an automated test framework that enables developers to continuously extend the test suite.

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, robustness, and end-to-end system tests in SIL, HIL, and real-system environments.

  • Work closely with software developers, systems engineers, hardware engineers, simulation teams, flight-test teams, and product stakeholders.




What you bring to the team:

  • A successfully completed degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or a comparable qualification (e.g., ISTQB certification)

  • 3+ years of experience in system / software testing or working in similar role

  • Experience analyzing system and software requirements and deriving traceable verification artefacts using requirements management tools

  • Strong understanding of complex system architectures and experience executing and troubleshooting end-to-end tests across software and hardware components

  • Practical experience in building hardware/software-in-the-loop setups, from concept to implementation

  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted test specification / software development, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI agent frameworks applied to software testing and automation is a strong plus.

  • Proficiency in developing, optimizing and maintaining automated test cases using Python or a comparable language

  • Hands-on experience with Robot test automation framework

  • Experience with CI/CD tools (ideally GitHub) and Docker

  • Experience with DO-178C is advantageous

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Proactive, organized and a team player mindset

  • Ability to balance multiple assignments

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.


Our commitment:

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Paid Media Manager
jobs.description:
Paid Media Manager

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Paid Media Manager to scale our paid acquisition across the full funnel and every segment—self-serve, developer, and enterprise–for emerging channels (e.g. Reddit, Snap, programmatic, et al). This role owns strategy and execution across the paid funnel, from channel mix and budget to creative testing and landing-page alignment, and is expected to find profitable, scalable growth through experimentation and data-driven decision making.

The ideal candidate is platform agnostic, with proven, hands-on experience across multiple paid channels. You should be as comfortable optimizing for self-serve signups as you are for demo requests and lead quality, and as fluent in creative testing as you are in attribution and CAC math. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with creative, lifecycle, landing-page, product marketing, and sales to drive impact.

What you will do

  • Own full-funnel paid media strategy and execution across self-serve, developer, and enterprise segments

  • Build scalable systems for paid acquisition, with strong attention to CAC, payback, and pipeline/conversion quality

  • Manage channel mix and budget allocation across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and emerging channels

  • Partner with creative on ad concepts and run a high-velocity creative testing program

  • Work with landing-page, lifecycle, and sales teams to align full-funnel journeys

  • Move fast: run A/B tests, analyze performance, iterate quickly, and document learnings

  • Instrument tracking, attribution, and reporting so paid impact is measurable end-to-end

  • Elevate experimentation velocity and platform diversity to uncover untapped growth

Requirements

  • Proven track record of scaling paid programs profitably across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other channels

  • Hands-on platform expertise—you’ve personally built and optimized campaigns, not just managed an agency

  • Strong analytical chops—you understand attribution, tracking, and LTV vs CAC math without needing a second opinion

  • Experience running creative testing and collaborating closely with creative teams on high-performing ads

  • Experience aligning campaigns to full-funnel journeys across self-serve and sales-led motions

  • Clear communicator with the ability to write high-intent copy and brief creative

  • You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

Bonus

  • Experience marketing to technical audiences (e.g., developers, APIs, infrastructure)

  • Familiarity with both self-serve and sales-led motions

  • Experience standing up reporting systems or collaborating with data/BI teams

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead the paid media function across all channels and segments as the team scales

  • Expand into broader growth or demand generation leadership

  • Move into full-funnel growth strategy or a channel-owner leadership role

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in NA and EU. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, and Warsaw.

jobs.title: First RevOps
jobs.description:
First RevOps

At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.

The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.

Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission

Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.

Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.

You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do

Own Attio, end to end

  • Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

  • Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

  • Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

  • Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense

  • Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

  • Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

  • Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

  • Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable

  • Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

  • Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

  • Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double

  • Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

  • Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes

You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.

Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win

  • You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

  • A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

  • Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure

  • Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

  • Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption

  • Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

  • Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

  • Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works

  • The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

  • The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are

The non-negotiable

  • You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential

  • 3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

  • Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

  • At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

  • Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

  • Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

  • You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have

  • A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values

  • Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

  • High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

  • Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process

  1. First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

  2. Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

  3. Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

  4. Founder interview with Paul

  5. Reference checks, with your consent

  6. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

  • A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

  • The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

  • An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

  • Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

  • Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

  • Room to grow. The role starts hands-on, with the prospect of building a team as the function grows

  • Competitive package. A competitive salary and equity (BSPCE), so you share in what you help build

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)

As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: Staff Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Product Security Engineer

Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

About the role

This is UpGuard's first dedicated product security hire. You'll have significant ownership over the direction of product security at UpGuard as we scale. You won't be inheriting someone else's decisions. You'll be defining the security standards, tooling, and practices that protect UpGuard's products and infrastructure for years to come.

In this role, you'll work across our product and production environments: performing security reviews, managing vulnerabilities, and running detection and response operations in our cloud-native infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with our product engineering and platform teams to secure our products, CI/CD pipelines, and production systems, and to embed security into how we build from the ground up.

The full remit of product security is broad, so we've been deliberate about sequencing. In your first 6–12 months you'll:

  • Refresh threat modelling and security review as a standard part of how we ship.

  • Figure out where AI actually helps in AppSec (code review, triage, coverage) and build what works

  • Harden our GCP and Kubernetes baseline and get secure-by-default configs into infrastructure-as-code

The function sits at the heart of our engineering organisation, and you'll have genuine autonomy and influence: defining the security roadmap, driving best practices, and scaling our security posture as we grow.

This is a Staff-level individual contributor role.

What you'll do

  • Lead threat modelling and security reviews across UpGuard's product portfolio and cloud infrastructure, proactively surfacing attack vectors and designing mitigation strategies that scale with growth.

  • Build automation, policy-as-code, and AI-driven security tooling that lets product engineering teams "shift left" and embeds security across the SDLC, leveraging agentic workflows to triage, review, and scale the reach of a lean security function.

  • Design and implement secure-by-default configurations for cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure.

  • Own vulnerability management end-to-end, triaging and prioritizing by real risk, driving remediation with engineering teams, and building preventative controls across the software supply chain from development through production.

  • Build scalable detection and response systems that catch malicious activity, triage the noise, and run incidents end to end.

  • Build deep partnerships with our product engineering and platform teams, helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions.

You'll be building a function, not inheriting one; with real executive backing, at a company where product security is core to the business rather than a cost centre. Our engineering culture values iteration, collaboration, and speed, with a no-ego approach and pragmatic trade-offs. We're fully remote with optional offices in Sydney and Hobart, and no mandatory office attendance.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering and/or software engineering/or security operations, work in cloud environments, with a focus on the below:

  • Cloud security experience (GCP preferred, but AWS or Azure is welcome)

  • Cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and strong container security principles

  • Strong understanding of securing IAM and cloud identities

  • Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, running threat modelling exercises, and turning findings into security controls engineering teams can implement.

  • Strong knowledge of common web application vulnerabilities and how to prevent them (OWASP Top 10 and similar).

  • Hands-on experience with IAC and related tools (preferably Terraform/OpenTofu)

What will give you an edge?

  • Experience as the first security hire or founding member of a security function at a scaling company.

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks (e.g. OWASP LLM Top 10) and securing AI-powered product features.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, particularly in Go

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audits from an engineering perspective.

  • Public security research, CVEs, open-source security tooling, or conference talks.

  • Offensive security skills, with the ability to validate findings through hands-on exploitation.

What's in it for you?

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.

  • Stock options: Share in UpGuard's growth and long-term success

jobs.title: Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - Europe
jobs.description:
Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - Europe

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this is a remote role that is to be based out of one of the following countries:

  • United Kingdom

  • Ireland

  • Scotland

  • Switzerland

  • Germany

  • Austria

  • Netherlands

  • Spain

Opportunity

Deepgram is expanding globally and operating a follow-the-sun model. We are hiring a Pre-sales Solutions Engineer in EMEA to win complex technical evaluations, design clear solution paths, and drive repeatable adoption for strategic accounts. Our strategic Account Executives do not hand off their customers after the first sale, so you will partner long-term across discovery, POC, production launch, and expansion. You will focus on pre-sales, yet you will often step into post-sales style work when the stakes are high and continuity matters.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram

Applied Engineering blends what many companies split into Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Solutions Consulting, and Technical Support. We are builders and communicators who bridge sales and engineering. We help customers move from problem to production with speed, clarity, and measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead technical discovery for strategic opportunities. Map business goals to measurable technical success criteria and an evaluation plan.

  • Design, scope, and execute POCs that prove value. Define datasets, metrics, and timelines that land a clear technical win.

  • Build lightweight prototypes, sample integrations, and demos using Deepgram SDKs and APIs. Show, do not tell.

  • Advise on architecture for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. Cover cloud, self-hosted, hybrid, and data residency needs.

  • Run security and compliance threads common in EMEA. Prepare crisp responses for GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and vendor risk reviews.

  • Triage and debug issues during evaluations. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to unblock customers quickly.

  • Create reusable assets that scale. Turn repeated requests into working samples, reference architectures, runbooks, and field guides.

  • Partner with Solutions Architects and Support for seamless continuity after initial wins. Stay involved through expansion phases when needed.

  • Enable the field. Collaborate with AEs, CSMs, and partners on positioning, demos, and technical validation for priority use cases.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with procurement, InfoSec, and data privacy expectations across EMEA, including GDPR and data residency.

Your First 90 Days

In the first weeks you will pick up low-risk customer tickets to learn our systems and support flow, then progress to pre-sales escalations tied to active opportunities and engagements driven by Account Executives or partners.

First 30 days

  • Ramp on Deepgram’s product surface area, platform APIs, SDKs, evaluation methodology, and security review materials.

  • Shadow strategic discovery and POC calls.

  • Triage and resolve low-risk tickets with a Solutions Architect or Support partner. Focus on reproductions, log and trace collection, SDK setup issues, and clear notes and handoffs.

  • Publish one internal field guide that clarifies a common EMEA pre-sales topic (for example data residency, telephony capture, or evaluation metrics).

By day 60

  • Own two evaluations end to end with defined success criteria and timelines.

  • Serve as the named technical partner for one or two strategic AEs. Run weekly technical deal reviews and prepare objection handling packs.

  • Take point on higher signal tickets related to your evaluations, coordinating fast fixes with Product, Engineering, and Support.

  • Deliver one live demo that becomes a reusable asset for the region. Pair with a Solutions Architect on a production launch to learn handoffs and escalation paths.

By day 90

  • Act as the primary pre-sales technical owner for several opportunities and expansions within strategic accounts.

  • Close at least one complex technical win with a measurable impact on revenue.

  • Lead one customer architecture workshop that documents a reference plan for production rollout or expansion.

  • Convert repeated ticket patterns into a runbook, sample, or accelerator and present a short readout on the impact.

You Will Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy the mix of customer conversations and hands-on building.

  • Can move from whiteboard to working code and back without losing the thread.

  • Communicate clearly with executives and deeply with engineers.

  • Value speed with rigor and crisp documentation.

  • Like winning together across regions and functions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years in Solutions Engineering or a similar customer-facing technical role focused on pre-sales.

  • Professional software engineering experience in at least one language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Rust. You can build POCs and tools that real users run.

  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud platforms. Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, networking fundamentals, and secure API design.

  • Proven track record leading POCs for enterprise customers and earning the technical win.

  • Clear written and verbal communication across both technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with speech recognition, TTS, voice quality analysis, or AI agents that orchestrate LLMs.

  • Familiarity with telephony and real-time media concepts such as SIP, WebRTC, streaming, and WebSocket integrations.

  • Experience with self-hosted and hybrid deployments, including Helm-based installs and production observability.

  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and data residency topics that appear in EMEA enterprise reviews.

  • Fluency in an additional European language such as German, French, Dutch, Italian, or Spanish.

How We Work

  • Remote across EMEA with periodic regional meetups.

  • Close partnership with AEs, SAs, Product, and Engineering to support continuous coverage across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC.

  • Shared playbooks, defined escalation paths, and measurable SLAs.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter screen focused on experience, motivations, and logistics.

  • Hiring manager conversation focused on technical depth and customer impact.

  • Practical assessment that mirrors real work. Expect discovery, solution design, and a short hands-on exercise.

  • Panel interviews with cross-functional partners.

  • Simulated pre-sales engagement based on a case study, along with and architecture walkthrough of a past technical win. Show your approach to success criteria, trade offs, and outcomes.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Regional VP, Sales
jobs.description:
Regional VP, Sales

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you'll do

  • Lead & develop a high-performing sales team - Hire, onboard, and develop AEs across Spain. Coach reps on deal strategy, pipeline management, and execution. Create a culture of accountability, learning, and collaboration. Identify and grow future leaders on your team

  • Own regional performance - Own your regional number and forecast accuracy, Inspect pipeline quality and help unblock stalled deals. Drive consistent execution of our sales process. Partner with RevOps to ensure clean data and clear insights

  • Be deeply involved in deals - Join key customer and prospect conversations. Help reps navigate complex buying committees and late-stage deals. Support pricing, negotiation, and close strategy

What you'll bring

  • 10- 15+ years of experience in an Enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • People Leadership Experience: 5+ years managing, mentoring, and developing a high performing enterprise sales team.

  • Enterprise Experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota, and running end-to-end complex deals.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

Even better...

  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

  • Experience Building GTM Strategies: Building sales teams and sales motions from scratch, or from early stage growth.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. Senior Performance Video Creative - Consumer

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

jobs.description:
Research Scientist - 3D Reconstruction (SfM & SLAM)

SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist focused on 3D reconstruction. You will advance methods that recover accurate camera poses and geometry from real-world imagery, working with both classical multi-view geometry and state-of-the-art learned reconstructors. The work includes structure-from-motion, bundle adjustment, SLAM, or feed-forward reconstruction, with a focus on robustness, accuracy, and methods that hold up on diverse real-world data.

Responsibilities

  • Design camera pose estimators and 3D reconstructors.

  • Build robust SfM and camera tracking pipelines for a variety of input imaging sensors.

  • Develop bundle adjusters and nonlinear optimizers, including non-perspective camera formulations.

  • Integrate and extend SOTA feed-forward reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3)

  • Advance deep multi-view stereo, learned matching, and monocular depth methods for dense geometry.

  • Build evaluation metrics for pose accuracy and reconstruction quality, and drive improvements against public & internal benchmarks.

  • Scale reconstruction methods to large, diverse real-world datasets while keeping them reliable and efficient.

  • Collaborate with researchers to bring reconstruction advances into production systems.

Key Qualifications

  • PhD in computer vision with a research focus on 3D reconstruction; publications at top venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS).

  • Deep understanding of multi-view geometry: camera models, epipolar geometry, triangulation, PnP, etc.

  • Strong familiarity with SOTA deep reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3) and related areas such as deep MVS, learned matching, and monocular depth estimation.

  • Hands-on experience with SfM/SLAM systems (COLMAP, ORB-SLAM) and nonlinear least-squares solvers (Ceres).

  • Experience shipping production-grade 3D reconstruction systems is a strong plus.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills.

  • Comfortable debugging failure cases on challenging real-world data.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Robot Learning (VLA / WAM)
jobs.description:
Research Scientist - Robot Learning (VLA / WAM)

SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist to train the policies that turn a world model into a robot that acts. You will own vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, starting, including data, backbone, action representation, training runs, and the evaluation that tells us whether a policy is genuinely competent or merely lucky. A world model that understands geometry and physics still doesn't act on its own; the policy is what closes that gap. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already trained manipulation policies that worked, and who can say precisely why the ones that didn't failed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the training pipeline for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, from data to a policy running on a robot.

  • Contribute to setting the technical direction for embodied research at SpAItial.

  • Close the sim-to-real gap through domain randomization, system identification, and calibration, and build evaluation that predicts real-world transfer.

  • Adapt VLM backbones for control: encoder choice and adapter strategies, co-training.

  • Curate and weight the training mix across heterogeneous robot datasets, spanning differing embodiments, action spaces, and sensor setups.

  • Design action representation and decoding, including tokenization, chunking, diffusion, and flow-matching action experts.

  • Build the world-model components that predict future observations conditioned on action.

  • Run post-training: supervised fine-tuning onto target embodiments, and RL for robustness beyond demonstrations.

Key Qualifications

  • A PhD in robotics, machine learning, or computer vision with a robot learning focus, from the PhD alone or followed by industry experience.

  • Publications at top venues such as (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS or CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS), open-source work, and/or deployed systems.

  • Deep experience with modern robot policy designs (VLA, WAM, diffusion), trained end to end rather than fine-tuned from a released checkpoint.

  • Strong imitation learning fundamentals, and familiarity with RL fine-tuning of pretrained policies.

  • Fluency with VLM backbones and how to adapt them for control.

  • Expert Python and PyTorch, with multi-node distributed training experience (FSDP or equivalent).

Senior Software Engineer - Backend

About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Foundations team, the backend backbone that builds the reliable, scalable, fast systems everyone else at Encord builds on top of. The team's core challenges sit deep in distributed and data-intensive systems.

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Foundations plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today.

Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100; now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll help solve.

What you'll do

  • Take end-to-end ownership of significant projects within our database and processing systems, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring, and measuring impact

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • Contribute to performant protocols and APIs, such as our label-format API, that customers use directly

  • Tackle complex domains and immense scale with simple solutions

  • Raise the bar through code reviews, pairing, and helping engineers around you do their best work

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You want your work to have a tangible outcome for people. You're not satisfied with building products that do not see the light of day

  • You are a builder. You enjoy all aspects of building not only software but a complete product, and are comfortable moving across the stack when necessary

  • You enjoy problem-solving and thinking from first principles, reach for the simplest solution that works, and know when boring technology wins

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • 5+ years building large-scale backend infrastructure applications

  • Deep fluency in at least one high-level language (we use Python and TypeScript, but we care more about depth than the specific language)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring

  • Experience with data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus

Tech stack

We are technology-agnostic at Encord and are not looking for experience across all of these. As long as you're open to learning, please apply.

  • Backend: Python

  • Frontend: TypeScript and React

  • Deployment: Kubernetes

  • Infrastructure: GCP

  • Machine learning: PyTorch, CUDA, Ray

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture: the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our solutions optimise patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in-depth analysis of real-world data.

📝 Your Role

In a nutshell

You will join our engineering team as a Backend & Applied AI Engineer. Your role will focus primarily on a product used to structure real-world clinical data: developing and maintaining product services and APIs, improving performance and architecture, and strengthening production reliability.

You will also contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled features through code review and backend integration. In the short and medium term, the role is expected to be approximately 75% backend and 25% Applied AI. This split may evolve with team and product needs, without a predefined trajectory.

Your impact

  • Become progressively autonomous on the product backend during your first six months.

The team is mainly based in Paris and works remotely from France.
